network: localhost, no throttling, new isolated context per toy, CDP cache disabled
options: default look and options, fixed scene seed 424242
loadMetric: navigation start to first postrender after body[data-ready=true] for the requested toy; hook installed before toy loading
frameMetric: wall-clock intervals between PlayCanvas frameend events; includes update-only loops because rendering is on demand; separate rendered-frame counts and postrender times retained

heapMetric: Table heap is Runtime.getHeapUsage.usedSize after opening settling without forced GC; immediate first-ready and settled snapshots, including backingStorageSize, are both retained. Worker/native/GPU memory is excluded.
transferMetric: Derived openingPayloadBytes sums completed HTTP body payload by the start of the idle window, after 1500 ms settling. Page completions use Content-Length, worker initial scripts missing CDP completions use parent Resource Timing encodedBodySize, worker imports/font files use worker Resource Timing. Cached Resource Timing bodies with transferSize=0 count as zero. Headers/blob/data URLs are excluded. Aborted/incomplete bodies are excluded and their Content-Length upper bound is retained. CDP encoded byte totals and first-ready cutoffs are auxiliary raw observations.
collectorVersionNote: 81 retained version-2 cells use the same readiness hook, settling, heap snapshots, frameend/postrender sampling and request collection as version 3. Version 3 adds worker Resource Timing. Those 81 cells had no pending HTTP worker script; corresponding desktop version-3 worker inventories have zero HTTP resources. Preflight/version-1 and interrupted cells are excluded.
splatMetric: Settled base+picture count, plus rig-addon counts checked in separate same-default/same-seed contexts; Fluid lab adds observed fluid layer capacity (includes inactive slots). Original initial/settled/post-tap counts, census components and active fluid particles are retained.
frameDataEncoding: frame-samples.csv has series, sample index and unrounded interval_ms. frame-series.json maps every series to measurement index, device, toy, window and frameend/postrender event. measurements.json is ordered phone then desktop, each in catalog order.
